description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

RTX develops aerospace and defense technologies, including engine control and diagnostic systems. The Embedded Software Engineer I will contribute to requirements definition, software architecture, low-level C design, airworthiness compliance, hardware/software integration, debugging, and collaboration with cross-functional engineering teams.
Embedded C engineer developing and certifying avionics software through architecture, hardware integration, and debugging

Responsibilities:
• Contribute to requirements definition, software architecture, and low-level design activities for embedded software developed in C
• Assist development activities to support compliance with airworthiness standards (MIL-STD-516 and DO-178)
• Support hardware/software integration and debugging on target platforms using logic analyzers, emulators, and hardware test benches
• Collaborate with system architects and cross-functional engineering teams; communicate technical status, risks, and mitigation plans within the work area

Requirements:
• U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are authorized to access information under this program/contract
• Bachelors degree or higher in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or STEM major obtained by start date
• Minimum 3.0 GPA

Preferred:
• Demonstrated software programming experience in C, C++, Python
• Basic understanding of real-time embedded software concepts such as scheduling, concurrency, coherency
• Experience with real-time operating systems and multi-core processors
• Familiarity with SPI, MIL-STD-1394, MIL-STD-1553, and/or the Ethernet communication stacks
• Knowledge of Agile methodologies and software Configuration Management - JIRA and Git
